hermeticity.method: I first constructed focus-only models from 100:10 and its two supplied branch inventories. I then considered the sealed context cues in packet order, retaining every anchored mechanism that genuinely changed the focus reading, including non-dominant split-root activations.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed focus trace because the focus ayah and all context cues were visible in one sealed packet, not a strict staged discovery log. No target reading, tafsir, other reader output, or source outside the permitted prompt, schema, and packet was consulted.

discarded_or_unchanged: The audible panting image at 100:1 (ض ب ح, root_000901/B001) sharpened exertion but did not change the focus beyond ctx_kinetic_assay.
Morning as first daylight at 100:3 (ص ب ح, root_000839/B001) strengthened visibility and threshold, but by itself only repeated generic disclosure.
The drinking-cup and gaming-arrow images at 100:2 (ق د ح, root_001203/B006 and root_001203/B007) did not produce a focus-anchored mechanism distinct from stronger assay and liability models.
صُّدُورِ as a mere portion of something (ص د ر, root_000849/B006) supplied plurality but no changed reading with a functional mechanism.
The direct anatomical chest image (ص د ر, root_000849/B001) remained a locus in several models; anatomy alone did not constitute an additional reading.

strongest_changes: The adjacent passive container-lines became an inverse excavation: graves are scattered outward while breasts are gathered inward into a decisive result.
The opening kinetic sequence changed inner extraction from a static unveiling into a forceful chain of ignition, disturbance, central penetration, and recollection.
Witnessing signs, distinguishing traces, and knowledge of the interior changed حُصِّلَ into forensic reconstruction of the source from what issued from it.
Love, perceived benefit, and tight binding changed the breasts from a store of propositions into a motivational topology organized by a governing attachment.
Nurture opposed to cutting and barren soil activated a relational yield, while seed, overturned earth, kernel, and dregs activated a coexisting winnowing model.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports opposed operations at once: gathering to a gist, extracting a kernel, and preserving residue. Context did not collapse these. Split-root count/return and trace activations opened accounting and forensic readings; material branches opened excavation, winnowing, hydrological sediment, digestive storage, developmental fruit, and liability models. The oddest readings remain explicitly exploratory but anchored.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive focus construction does not itself identify the acting agent; 100:11 may guide that inference without grammatically forcing every model to name it.
Non-dominant split-root activations are legitimate packet material but should not be mistaken for claims that the surface forms lexically denote counting, return, traces, or growth.
It remains open whether kernel and dregs are simultaneous products of one assay or alternative branch-level construals.
The kinetic, agricultural, hydrological, digestive, and developmental mechanisms may be analogical activations rather than semantic specifications of حُصِّلَ.
The evidentiary model can coexist with direct inner knowledge; the packet does not decide whether reconstruction is epistemically necessary or only renderable.
